THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
WINTER
048
STUDY 088
Sleeveless Cable Knit & Shearling Boots
Rights check
Source: 24974.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
stands in a full-length pose against a pale studio
backdrop. She wears a gray sleeveless mock-neck
cable-knit top with a diamond cable pattern and a
cropped halter back, paired with a short gray wool mini
skirt. Tall dark gray suede boots with plush fur trim and
buckle straps complete the look. Her expression is calm
and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of heathered
gray, charcoal, and cream. Sleek and cozy, in the style
of a minimalist winter catalog.
Sleek, cozy, wintry
WORKING NOTES
- The cable knit and fur-trimmed boots are the texture
pairing.
- Add 'head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
